title: Oceanic Flaky Uruguayan Clams Bake
description: Tangy, flaky, meal-prep Uruguayan dish featuring clams, double-rise-bread, and Ayurvedic tamasic-friendly ingredients. Serve in individual ramekins for a hearty, satisfying meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and cook, stirring frequently, for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the clams to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2-3 minutes, until they start to open.
Add the milk, Parmesan cheese, oregano, cumin, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Add the torn bread to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to 4-6 ramekins and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake, covered, for 15 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 5-10 minutes, until the bread is golden brown and the clams are cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
Let the clams bake for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the bread to become flaky.
Let the clams rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Serve with additional Parmesan cheese on top if desired.
